correctness.rationale: Rooted-tree unique-path percolation coupling identifies last infected generation with maximum depth of root open-edge component. Exact recursion Q_k(v)=1−∏_children(1−p Q_(k−1)(child)) and tail sum F=Σ_{k≥1}Q_k yield correct polynomials. Completeness for n≤7 follows from all Prüfer sequences for labeled trees and root choices, collapsed by canonical recursively sorted subtree code; 84 isomorphism classes in total. Each F was independently recomputed by a new NetworkX nonisomorphic-tree generator and independent branch-tail recursion and exact SymPy polynomial root counting, yielding frequencies n=2:(1,0,0), n=3:(2,0,0), n=4:(3,1,0), n=5:(5,4,0), n=6:(12,8,0), n=7:(28,19,1). Source CENSUS.csv has exactly one two-root row: 7-vertex three-armed spider (3,2,1), F=3p−p²+2p³−p⁴, Fʺ=−2+12p−12p² with two simple roots (3±√3)/6 and strict −,+,− signs. No statement about n>7.
residual_risks: Independently reproduced class counts are exhaustive for n≤7, not for arbitrary larger rooted trees.
